name: The Line Is Wherever You Are

description.value: While you are conscious, no ally within your reach can be dropped below 1 Hit Point by an attack you could have intercepted. You do not have to see it coming and you do not have to have a reaction left. The line does not break, because you are still standing on it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Claims no ally in reach can be dropped below 1 HP by an attack the caster "could have intercepted" -- again gated on an unused hypothetical, not an actual reaction spent. Same gap as behind-me-means-safe: no precedent found for a guarantee this strong tied to a hypothetical action, and no selector prevents a different creature's own HP from dropping regardless.
